seed_ledger.name: Bluegrass power station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: searched EIA-style project news, Ohio Power Siting Board approval coverage, trade press (Pipeline and Gas Journal results cover other central Ohio data center lines), and several name variants. The approval coverage says only that the 800 MW plant is behind the meter and gives no gas supply. No FERC, air permit or utility source found naming the gas supply. Texas Gas Borealis (P7794) and Eastern Gas Transmission (P3220) are nearby, not confirmed.

evidence.note: approval coverage, no gas supply named

seed_ledger.name: Colossus 1 power station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: ONSITE_NO_PIPE: no source found for a named pipeline. Cleanview says Colossus 1 runs on about 198 MW of on-site gas turbines plus grid power and names no pipeline; it also says the Colossus 2 site has only a small domestic gas line. The earlier MLGW tap claim was not confirmed, so this stays a local distribution supply with no new pipe found.

evidence.note: turbines on site, no pipeline named

seed_ledger.name: Dickson City Power Plant (gas supply)
